purpose: Real Wayland Computer Use capture/input evidence profile; X11 fallback must remain fallback-only.

requiredSession.compositor: Sway/wlroots headless or nested session, GNOME Shell, or KDE KWin Wayland with a matching portal backend
requiredSession.dbus: session DBus visible to xdg-desktop-portal and org.a11y.Bus
requiredSession.capture: xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast consent dialog returning PipeWire node
requiredSession.input: libei/AT-SPI2/uinput adapter after explicit local approval
requiredSession.uinput: /dev/uinput writable only through installer-approved group or udev rule

ciCommandSketch: start pipewire and wireplumber in the session
start a Wayland compositor first; prefer WLR_BACKENDS=headless sway or nested sway for CI
start xdg-desktop-portal plus backend (wlr for sway/wlroots, gtk/gnome/kde only for matching desktops)
collect portal approve/deny/revoke screenshots/logs; do not substitute X11 for VAL-CU-001

packageProbe.command: bash -lc for bin in dbus-run-session sway swaymsg weston gnome-shell kwin_wayland xdg-desktop-portal xdg-desktop-portal-wlr xdg-desktop-portal-gtk pipewire wireplumber pw-cli gdbus at-spi-bus-launcher grim; do   if command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s=%s\n" "$bin" "$(command -v "$bin")"; else printf "%s=missing\n" "$bin"; fi; done
packageProbe.stdout:
dbus-run-session=/usr/bin/dbus-run-session
sway=missing
swaymsg=missing
weston=missing
gnome-shell=missing
kwin_wayland=missing
xdg-desktop-portal=missing
xdg-desktop-portal-wlr=missing
xdg-desktop-portal-gtk=missing
pipewire=/usr/bin/pipewire
wireplumber=missing
pw-cli=/usr/bin/pw-cli
gdbus=/usr/bin/gdbus
at-spi-bus-launcher=missing
grim=missing

blockerRows.reason: No interactive Wayland session in evidence environment (platform=linux, XDG_SESSION_TYPE=).
blockerRows.unblock: Run on GNOME/KDE Wayland with xdg-desktop-portal and PipeWire session bus.

blockerRows.reason: ScreenCast portal was not reachable on the session bus.
blockerRows.unblock: Start an interactive desktop session with xdg-desktop-portal backend.
Enable accessibility bus in the desktop session.

blockerRows.reason: /dev/uinput missing or not writable by the test user.
blockerRows.unblock: Provision uinput group/udev policy for explicit installer-approved input.
